name: freetier
description: You can use the Amazon Web Services Free Tier API to query programmatically your Free Tier usage data.

subcommands.name: get-account-activity
subcommands.description: Returns a specific activity record that is available to the customer.

subcommands.name: get-account-plan-state
subcommands.description: This returns all of the information related to the state of the account plan related to Free Tier.

subcommands.name: get-free-tier-usage
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all Free Tier usage objects that match your filters.

subcommands.name: list-account-activities
subcommands.description: Returns a list of activities that are available.

subcommands.name: upgrade-account-plan
subcommands.description: The account plan type for the Amazon Web Services account.
